rule: Every hostile is a planted defect arm whose expected effect is known in advance; a hostile that does NOT flip its target row is itself a defect to report. Hostile results are first-class evidence, never discarded.

hostiles.expected: root validity contaminated through every derivation using the rule; oracle must detect

hostiles.expected: induction licence gone; naive checker loops or falsely accepts
